text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You were so focused, your face was<n>practically
planted right onto the glass.<n>I could tell from back
here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how in the world you<n>managed to
maintain your<n>concentration in such a raucous
environment. Perhaps you can teach<n>me later.
